atoms.text: Australia has a very long coastline, over 36,000 kilometres. The coast looks different in various areas. The east coast has many pretty beaches, coral reefs and rain forests. Some famous places are the Gold Coast, Sunshine Coast, and Bondi Beach. There's also the Great Barrier Reef, which is very famous.

The west coast is very different. It's less developed and has rugged coastlines, cliffs, and deserts. There are many beautiful places to visit, like the Kimberley region, Ningaloo Reef, and Margaret River wine region.

atoms.text: The south coast is also rugged and wild, with big waves, and small fishing villages. The Great Ocean Road is very popular and has pretty views of the Twelve Apostles and other natural wonders. The Twelve Apostles are towering rock formations that have been shaped by the forces of wind and ocean waves.
The north and north-east coast are tropical and have many white sandy beaches, clear water, and rainforests. You can visit the Whitsunday Islands, Cairns, and Daintree Rainforest.
